task.description:
Run the full integration suite after TEST-DESIGNER has added TC-DB-02-03 and TC-DB-02-04. Confirm both new tests pass against a live PostgreSQL database.

## Pre-flight

```
docker compose up -d db_test
docker compose exec db_test pg_isready -U bpm
BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test zig build migrate
```

## Test runs

```
zig build test
BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test zig build test-integration
```

## Acceptance criteria
- `zig build test` exits 0
- `zig build test-integration` exits 0
- TC-DB-02-03 PASS
- TC-DB-02-04 PASS
- All 17 previously-passing tests still PASS (no regressions)
- Total integration test count is now 19

result.summary: All 19 integration tests pass (19/19). TC-DB-02-03 PASS, TC-DB-02-04 PASS, no regressions in prior 17 tests. Blocker resolved: docker-compose.yml db_test service now sets max_connections=250 to support pool_size=200 boundary test.

issues.description: First run failed: PostgreSQL default max_connections=100 rejected connections beyond the limit during pool_size=200 boundary test. pg.zig mapped the ErrorResponse to AuthenticationFailed. Fix: added 'postgres -c max_connections=250' to db_test in docker-compose.yml. Test passed after container recreation.
